downstack-under-pressure.roadmap_item: 1 — Pre-register `downstack rate under pressure` BEFORE the next session is recorded
downstack-under-pressure.hypothesis: paired AUC, winner vs loser, of rows cleared per piece over locks whose PRE-lock board carries at least one garbage row, over the verified prefix; one-sided, winner higher
unblinding: CLAUDE.md publishes the UNCONDITIONAL per-piece DS paired AUC for both banked sessions (08-09: 66.0, 08-14: 70.2). That is not the registered estimand — the registered one conditions on garbage being on the pre-lock board — but the two are correlated, so the bank is partially unblinded and the confirmatory test must be reported as such.

2026-08-19 is banked on the same terms and with the same caveat: CLAUDE.md's AUC block publishes its UNCONDITIONAL per-piece DS paired AUC (73.6) alongside the other six. Again that is not the registered estimand — which conditions on garbage being on the pre-lock board — but it is correlated, so this session enters the bank partially unblinded exactly as 08-09 and 08-14 did. Recorded at the time of banking rather than discovered at analysis time.

2026-08-25 is banked on the same terms and with the same caveat: CLAUDE.md's AUC block publishes its UNCONDITIONAL per-piece DS paired AUC (66.4) alongside the other seven. Again that is not the registered estimand — which conditions on garbage being on the pre-lock board — but it is correlated, so this session enters the bank partially unblinded exactly as 08-09, 08-14 and 08-19 did. Recorded at the time of banking rather than discovered at analysis time. Four banked sessions now carry an identical caveat; that is a standing property of how this repo publishes, not four separate lapses, and the confirmatory test must report it once.

2026-09-03 is banked, but its unblinding is LARGER than the standing caveat above and must not be reported as the same sentence. The four sessions before it each published one correlated number — the unconditional per-piece DS paired AUC. This session's report makes the correlated quantity its CENTRAL FINDING: hand claim C012 pins garbage-cleared-per-piece for both players over two match windows and states that it crosses over at the m3 break, and the hero, moments, stats and coaching sections all build on that. Its unconditional per-piece DS AUC is 59.8 (raw 62.0), the lowest of the nine. The registered estimand — which conditions on garbage being on the PRE-lock board, over the verified prefix — has still never been computed on this session or on any banked one, so the bank is not spent; but a confirmatory test that quotes the standing one-line caveat would understate what a reader of 2026-09-03's report already knows. If the confirmatory test cannot carry that, drop this session from the bank rather than soften the disclosure.

2026-09-10 is banked and its unblinding sits BETWEEN the standing one-line caveat and 2026-09-03's. Like the five before it, CLAUDE.md's AUC block publishes its unconditional per-piece DS paired AUC (65.4, raw 70.0). More than that, its report publishes a pooled per-piece downstack COMPARISON between the two players — 0.262% apart, cited as G073 in the stats panel and in the trivia — as an argument that the column is level. That is a session-level aggregate over all rounds, not a per-round paired statistic and not the registered estimand (which conditions on garbage being on the PRE-lock board, over the verified prefix), so it is weaker unblinding than 2026-09-03's C012, which pinned a windowed per-piece downstack CROSSOVER and made it that night's central finding. It is nonetheless more than the bare AUC the first four banked sessions carried. Recorded at the time of banking. The registered estimand has still never been computed on any banked session, so the bank is not spent; the confirmatory test must report three tiers of disclosure, not one.

2026-09-11 is banked and its unblinding is the STANDING ONE-LINE CAVEAT, not 2026-09-03's or 2026-09-10's. Like every banked session, CLAUDE.md's AUC block publishes its unconditional per-piece DS paired AUC (71.6, raw 70.6 — the second-highest of the eleven). That is the whole of it: this session's report makes no downstack claim, its hand ledger pins no per-piece downstack quantity, and no section argues from one, so it carries strictly less disclosure than 2026-09-03 (whose C012 pinned a windowed per-piece downstack crossover as the night's central finding) and less than 2026-09-10 (whose report published a pooled per-piece downstack comparison as G073). The registered estimand — which conditions on garbage being on the PRE-lock board, over the verified prefix — has still never been computed on any banked session, so the bank is not spent. Recorded at the time of banking. The three tiers of disclosure the confirmatory test must report are unchanged in kind; this session joins the largest and weakest of them, which now holds six of the seven banked sessions.

2026-09-17 is banked, and its unblinding is a DIFFERENT KIND from the three tiers above rather than a larger or smaller amount of the same one — it must not be folded into any of them. Like every banked session, CLAUDE.md's AUC block publishes its unconditional per-piece DS paired AUC (79.6, raw 78.6 — the second-highest of the twelve, behind 2026-08-01's 84.0). What is new is that THIS SESSION'S REPORT quotes that paired AUC itself, in yachi's coaching column, as the argument that downstacking is his strong column ('全晚 DS 嘅 AUC 79.6，係十二晚第二高'), alongside G084's per-round per-piece downstack comparison for the deep round (.367 against .309). Every earlier banked session left the paired AUC to CLAUDE.md and published at most a pooled session aggregate in the report (2026-09-10's G073) or a windowed hand claim (2026-09-03's C012). Why that is a different kind and not merely more: the registered estimand IS a paired AUC of rows cleared per piece, winner vs loser — what the registration adds is the CONDITION that the pre-lock board carry a garbage row, over the verified prefix. So a reader of this report has been shown the registered statistic with its conditioning removed, which is nearer in form to the estimand than a pooled per-piece aggregate is, while still not being it. That is the most informative partial unblinding the bank has taken short of computing the estimand. The registered estimand has still never been computed on this or any banked session, so the bank is NOT spent. Recorded at the time of banking, and deliberately not avoided: the sentence in the coaching column is true and is the useful thing to tell that player, so the right move is to disclose it here rather than to delete it from the report to protect the bank. The confirmatory test must now report FOUR kinds of disclosure, and this one first, because it is the closest to the estimand.

2026-09-19 is banked, and its unblinding is 2026-09-10's TIER — a pooled per-piece downstack comparison in the report — not the standing one-line caveat. A first draft of this entry said the standing caveat and was wrong, which is recorded rather than quietly fixed: the check was to grep the session's own prose for the downstack claim id instead of reasoning from what the report was 'about'. Like every banked session, CLAUDE.md's AUC block publishes the unconditional per-piece DS paired AUC (72.3, raw 74.0). Beyond that, this session's report cites G088 — pinglamb's session-pooled garbage-cleared-per-piece above yachi's, .2071 against .1884 — in BOTH the 數據對決 stats panel and pinglamb's coaching column. That is a session-level aggregate over all rounds, not a per-round paired statistic and not the registered estimand (which conditions on garbage being on the PRE-lock board, over the verified prefix), so it is weaker than 2026-09-03's windowed C012 crossover and much weaker than 2026-09-17's, which quoted the paired AUC itself. It is the same kind as 2026-09-10's G073. What IS new here is size and it cuts the other way: 150 rounds is 1.79x the largest session already banked and about a quarter of the whole bank, so the confirmatory test's power now rests substantially on one night, and reporting n without reporting that concentration would overstate the bank's independence. The registered estimand has still never been computed on this or any banked session, so the bank is not spent.

2026-09-18 is banked, and its unblinding is 2026-09-10's and 2026-09-19's TIER — a pooled per-piece downstack comparison cited in the report — with one qualification in each direction, and it is recorded because this session arrives OUT OF DATE ORDER (it is the night before 2026-09-19 and was added after it), so 'the last banked session' and 'the most recent night' are no longer the same session. Like every banked session, CLAUDE.md's AUC block publishes the unconditional per-piece DS paired AUC (70.9, raw 72.4). Beyond that this session's report cites G089 twice — in the 數據對決 stats panel and in yachi's coaching column — which is the same KIND of aggregate as 2026-09-10's G073 and 2026-09-19's G088. WEAKER in one respect: G089 is ORDINAL ('yachi's session downstack per piece is higher than pinglamb's') and prints no pair of numbers, where G073 published a 0.262% gap and G088 published .2071 against .1884. STRONGER in one respect: the 關鍵時刻 section cites G100, the per-round per-piece downstack pair for the selected round (.313 against .227) — the same additional quantity 2026-09-17 carried beside its much larger disclosure. What this session does NOT do is quote the paired AUC itself, which is what made 2026-09-17 a different kind; so it stays in the third tier and does not join the first. The registered estimand — which conditions on garbage being on the PRE-lock board, over the verified prefix — has still never been computed on this or any banked session, so the bank is not spent. On SIZE, the concentration 2026-09-19's entry flagged is now worse and must be reported as such: the bank holds 10 sessions and 765 rounds, of which 2026-09-19 is 20% and this session 17% — **36% of the confirmatory test's power now rests on two ADJACENT NIGHTS**, which is a sharper caveat than one night carrying a quarter of it, because two consecutive sessions are not two independent draws of whatever was true of how these two were playing that week. Reporting n without reporting that would overstate the bank's independence more than it did one session ago.

deviations.what: The estimand is pinned to the CURRENT instrument — runCaseOracle over the post-hoisted-DAS verified prefix — rather than to the instrument that existed at registration. 08-09 and 08-14 stay in the confirmatory bank.
deviations.why: Between registration (2026-08-07) and this pin the verified prefix grew ~31% (hoisted-DAS fix c9f3065, 2026-08-11) and the board source moved to runCaseOracle (a38ccc1, 2026-08-12). board-metrics.ts itself was last touched 2026-08-06 (f5ee923) and still imports the hand-port runCase, so 'as computed today' named an instrument the rest of the repo has demoted. Both changes were made for documented drift reasons, blind to this hypothesis, and the estimand has never been computed on the banked sessions. Estimand, unit, direction, test, threshold and controls are unchanged, so this is a deviation in instrument, not a new hypothesis.

deviations.what: The estimand's import closure moved: `pipeline/sim/forecast.ts` gained a same-frame branch in `localiseMechanism`. The pin advances to the commit carrying it. All thirteen sessions stay classified as they were; 2026-09-19 joins the confirmatory bank. The pin was re-advanced within this same deviation when a COMMENT in the same file was corrected (the same-frame counts had been read off a truncated scan); no second deviation is recorded because the substantive change is the one above and the closure's behaviour is unaltered.
deviations.why: `boards[]` is indexed per lock but snapshotted per FRAME, so when two locks share a frame the snapshot after the first already contains the second and the step model — place one piece, clear, snapshot — is not what happened. The existing assertion caught this on 2026-09-19 (replay-2026-09-19-06.ttrm r4 yachi, lock 151); it had been dormant rather than absent, since 24 such locks exist across 8 sessions, over 23 player-rounds, and 15 sit inside a verified prefix, but none had previously lain on a step this function walks. The branch reconstructs the whole same-frame run, still asserts it against boards[t], and returns `unattributed` because a step holding two placements cannot attribute an availability rise to one of them. THE RELEVANT FACT FOR THIS REGISTRATION is that the change is INERT on the banked data: every prior session's sim/forecast-facts.json re-emits byte-identical, which was checked on all seven sessions that contain same-frame locks before the pin was advanced. So the instrument did not move on any banked session — it gained a branch that fires on one round of the newest one. Estimand, unit, direction, test, threshold and controls are unchanged, and `board-metrics.ts` itself is untouched; this is a deviation in the closure, not in the hypothesis. The change was made to emit the new session's artefact at all, blind to this registration, and the registered estimand has still never been computed on any banked session.
